title: Expedition Files
description:
S03 E02 — Madness Explained
Was witchcraft at work during the Salem witch trials, or an undiagnosed psychological illness?; did Britain's famous UFO sighting by officials have a more earthly explanation?; who's really responsible for the murder of the Mad Monk of Russia?

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E12 — Smoke and Mirrors
Josh Gates explores how new evidence reshapes history's mysteries: a fresh analysis of Edgar Allan Poe's death; a novel take on Ponce de León's quest for the Fountain of Youth.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S03 E03 — Time Reveals All
A body is found on a beach with only a cryptic note; the Trojan War and the Trojan Horse were once thought to be pure myth, but the discovery of ruins reveals they were all too real; new evidence may prove Shakespeare didn't write his own works.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E04 — Under Pressure
Josh Gates reopens cases where the truth stayed buried -- he exposes new clues, alibis and revelations that challenge everything that we thought we know about Noah's Ark, the terror of anthrax attacks and Bugsy Siegel's murder.

title: Expedition Files
description:
S04 E06 — Fact or Fiction?
Josh Gates investigates Dracula, Cold War psychic spying and Spartacus; from Vlad the Impaler's infamous reign of terror, to secret U.S. mind-control tests and a gladiator who defied Rome.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E03 — Death Jars of Laos
Deep in the Laos jungle, Josh must detonate Vietnam War bombs before searching for a lost culture's burial jars; 3D scanning and facial recognition could expose this mysterious civilization.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S17 E04 — Sunken City of Pirates
A survey reveals a submerged pirate lair located off the coast of Jamaica; using photogrammetry, Josh dives in to hunt for the $50M stolen treasure of Black Bart, the King of Pirates.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S02 E04 — Hunting Vampires
Josh explores the history of vampirism in Romania and Bulgaria.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S07 E06 — The Search For Florida's Lost Pirate
Josh Gates sets sail for Florida chasing the long-lost treasure of bloodthirsty pirate Jose Gaspar; Josh joins marine archaeologists and treasure hunters working to crack the mysteries of the pirate's life so they can find the riches he left behind.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S06 E03 — Mysteries of Jesus
Josh Gates journeys to the Holy Land to find out where Jesus was born; his investigation leads to potentially explosive revelations that may change people's understanding of Jesus' origin story.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
Josh's Favorites: Traitors' Treasure of 1776
Josh chases the fortune stolen by loyalists to Britain's crown during the American Revolution.

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S31 E05 — Mountain Meadows Massacre
Zak and the crew head to Utah to visit the site of an infamous frontier massacre. Is the centuries-old shame from the senseless slaughter of innocent men, women and children fueling a malicious entity beneath a nearby town?

title: Ghost Adventures
description:
S31 E04 — Gold Canyon Curse
The crew investigates an abandoned Nevada mining town where visitors are being attacked by unseen forces.

description:
S07 E04 — Greatest Icons
Places that were once home to Hollywood films and world-famous musicians are now run-down, abandoned and off limits; experts investigate their mysteries and reveal the astonishing secrets behind 10 of the world's most iconic abandoned places.

title: Hustlers Gamblers Crooks
description:
S02 E01 — Movie Star Robber
Hollywood star Danny Trejo spills the secrets of his drug and crime-fueled youth in Los Angeles; a high-stakes card counter is caught between rival Russian mobs; a teenage car thief watches the ride of her life crash and burn.

title: Hustlers Gamblers Crooks
description:
S02 E06 — The Dirty Cop
A police officer stops fighting crime and starts committing it when he becomes a drug kingpin in the 1980s New York; a football star with crushed dreams turns to bank robbery; a down-on-his-luck accountant defrauds the U.S. government for big bucks.

title: Hustlers Gamblers Crooks
description:
S02 E08 — Fyre Fest Fiasco
An arms dealer defrauds the US government to earn a $300 million contract, inspiring the film "War Dogs."

title: Hustlers Gamblers Crooks
description:
S02 E03 — Cocaine Pizza
A father and son team up to sell drugs out of their family's pizzeria; a mom fed up with cooking her boss's books decides to steal her own piece of the pie; and a Chicago thief is so good at escaping the police that they nickname him Spider-Man.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E06 — Stadium Smackdowns
Around the world, wherever there's a playoff, a concert, even a peewee league game, there will be fists flying -- from angry fans in the stands to parents screaming on the sidelines.

title: Caught!
description:
S02 E17 — Animal Invasions
Nature's creatures don't always stay in the wild; from four-legged intruders to thieving beasts, when animals and humans meet -- these feisty critters won't back down.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E18 — Disorder in the Court
Courtroom chaos caught on camera; if the judge's gavel isn't enough to calm down criminals, brave bailiffs and cops have to step in; shocking attacks, escape attempts, and stolen firearms make for a very dramatic day in court.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E17 — Caught in the Act
Criminals and reprobates worldwide sneak into pockets, purses and beds; while some get away with their crimes, others are caught in the act, which leads to surprise arrests, fistfights and passionate acts of revenge.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E20 — High Crimes
In the United States, a whopping 250,000 federal prison sentences annually are fueled by drugs and alcohol; from big-shot drug dealers to inebriated road warriors, law enforcement is guarding people against danger.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E10 — Nature Strikes Back
Everything in nature wants to kill humans -- animals, gravity, even the weather; just when one thinks they've conquered nature, nature fights back -- from angry bison and gale-force winds to giant spiders and bear attacks.

title: Caught!
description:
Winner Takes All
All the comedy clip chips at the center of the table; lessons on all the hits, misses, and missteps.

title: Caught!
description:
Life on the Edge
A wild journey of outrageous clips; near-miss car crashes, avalanche disasters and a terrifying, death-defying glider ride.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E04 — Travel Hell
As travel stats reach new heights and patience hits rock bottom, millions of conflicts erupt in planes, trains and automobiles worldwide; from road rage to high-altitude meltdowns, it's a wild ride in the world of travel.

title: Caught!
description:
S01 E19 — Prisoners Gone Wild
Whether they're in Missouri, France or even Brazil, prisoners attempt hare-brained schemes to escape jail; they try to escape with the help of modern technology, a disguise and even a helicopter.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E01 — Living Life on the Edge
A damaged hauler carrying U.S. mail through Colorado shuts down I-70; hurricane-force winds in Wyoming leave a semi skewered; a jackknife on an icy overpass in Utah has the recovery crew at odds.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E02 — The Tunnel of Chaos
The I-70 Eisenhower Tunnel closes in both directions as a 78-vehicle pileup creates mass chaos; Mountain Recovery and Stauffer's Towing battle high winds and slick roads to clear wreckage and keep major highways moving.

title: Rocky Mountain Wreckers
description:
S02 E03 — Avalanche Country
Competing companies team up to recover a fully loaded cement truck leaking natural gas; Big Jon heads into avalanche country to rescue a stuck semi carrying hazardous goods; during a sudden blizzard, a crash in Salt Lake City leaves a semi in pieces.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S05 E10 — High-Rise Window Washer
Mike Rowe joins the crew of Worldwide Window Cleaning and climbs into a bosun's chair to clean windows 40 stories above downtown Honolulu, Hawaii.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S05 E06 — Spider Pharm
Mike learns how to make high-quality bird food in Payette, Idaho, and then milks spiders for their venom in Arizona.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S06 E08 — Bug Detective
Mike joins students from Purdue University who are digging through pig carcasses searching for maggots and other insects as they study what is known as PMI, or time of death.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S06 E25 — Fossil Hunter
Mike takes on his latest challenge, traveling to Utah to take on the surprisingly dirty job of being a paleontologist.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S06 E26 — Doomsday Seed Banker
The millennium seed project collects and preserves flora seeds for replanting after a catastrophic event.

title: Dirty Jobs
description:
S10 E13 — Deer Urine Farmer; Necropsy
Mike Rowe travels to Anna, Ill., and wades knee-deep in diarrhea to collect deer urine for America's buck-hunters; Mike strands Maryland's shore to perform a necropsy on an ocean sentinel to determine its cause of death.

description:
S01 E04 — Wild West Gold
Gold is still there for the taking in the heart of America's Wild West; a drought's end in the Black Hills of South Dakota has replenished the gold in its waterways, giving better access to everyday miners for the first time in years.

title: America's Backyard Gold
description:
S01 E03 — Big Dollar Beaches
Dave Turin welcomes viewers into his own backyard -- the state of Oregon; from the Rogue River rapids to the sands of the Pacific coastline, he shows viewers where the gold is and how to get it.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S13 E07 — Misery on Miracle Mountain
The off-grid dream of an Arkansas family spans three generations, they're struggling to make it work; a polar vortex hits mid-rescue and the Raneys must pivot fast to protect lives and salvage the homestead's future.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S14 E04 — Uphill Battle
The Raneys head to West Virginia to rescue a mountaintop homestead with over 300 animals and no water; but the land and its owners are stubbornly resisting the necessary changes, making the rescue one of their biggest challenges yet.

title: Homestead Rescue
description:
S14 E03 — Raney Returns: Revenge of the Treehouse of Horror
Marty heads back to Missouri to reinforce the Oglesbys' failing cabin, but upon discovering critical needs at their son's homestead, his mission doubles; can Marty save both cabins in a limited amount of time?

S01 E04 — Rolling Stones' Snooker Table; Aliens
Rolling Stones' snooker table; rare African artifacts; alien mannequins.

description:
S04 E05 — Dusk Till Dawn
The harvest is over, but that doesn't mean the work is too -- the farmers roll up their sleeves and get to work. Visits from Copperhead, Soil Warrior and Spraytec keep these operations at their best. The girls visit their friends in California.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E05 — Hillbilly Scotch
Josh's head spins when Jerry reveals his wild plans for their joint moonshine operation. Mark and Digger enlist a Scotsman to help craft the first Hillbilly Scotch.

title: Major League Fishing
description:
2026 Heavy Hitters Championship Round: Orange Lake
Heavy Hitters Qualifying Group A Day One from Marion County, FL. Anglers compete to win $100,000 as well as the $100,000 Big Bass Bonus.

description:
S07 E09 — Prison Escape
Adam and Jamie test if it's possible to cling to the roof of a speeding car; Kari, Tory and Grant try to solve some jailbreak myths.

description:
S06 E11 — Coffin Punch
The whole team gets together to test myths about survival; in Coffin Punch, Kari, Tory and Grant test the silver screen saga; Adam and Jamie question what bullet-proof is.

description:
S14 E11 — Zombie Special
Michael Rooker ("The Walking Dead") helps the team test zombie myths; the more effective weapon, ax or gun; testing the strength of the living dead; outrunning or outsmarting a horde.

title: MythBusters
description:
S13 E04 — Fright Night
Adam and Jamie see if certain sound frequencies can convince people of paranormal activity; finding out if the smell of fear exists.

description:
S01 E06 — Vanished in a Portal
A man captures a beam of light in the desert; a couple is convinced they communicated with a UFO; a military man thinks he discovered a portal.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E01 — You Saw a UFO
After the death of his father, a farmer believes he witnessed a UFO; a geologist uncovers debris at the Roswell crash site; after seeing an orb in the sky, a mother suffers radiation-like burns on her body.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E07 — Crash in California
A Nevada man sees an object ejecting something in the sky; concertgoers believe they saw a UFO; two brothers recover material from an alleged UFO crash site in Needles, Calif.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E05 — Proof from Area 51
A man shares an original Area 51 video from 1992 for the first time; multiple people capture a Texas UFO sighting; a man films an unusual hovering object in Utah.

title: Alien Encounters: Fact or Fiction
description:
S01 E03 — Haunted and Hunted
A lobsterman from Maine relives a harrowing encounter that has haunted him for years; a family witnesses a strange string of lights in the sky; a man believes he can communicate with alien crafts.

title: Expedition X
description:
S02 E05 — Devil in the Forest
After receiving brand-new, frightening reports, Josh sends Jessica and Phil to the woods of southern New Jersey to hunt for the infamous Jersey Devil; locals are terrified by a demonic creature that's terrorized them for more than 300 years.

title: Expedition X
description:
S01 E06 — The Amazon's Cursed Ruins
Expedition X explores an abandoned and haunted outpost in the Amazon rainforest; meeting with tribes deep in the jungle, they hear strange things at night that cause panic.

title: Expedition X
description:
S01 E03 — Terror on Doll Island
Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot power through camera malfunctions and emotional breakdowns in order to find an explanation of what is happening on the Island of the Dolls; a dangerous place that locals have long avoided.

title: Expedition X
description:
S05 E03 — Mexico's Haunted Cenotes
In the Yucatán, Phil and Jess investigate watery caverns believed to be portals to the Maya underworld; some say angry spirits are to blame for strange lights and bizarre animal behavior, but the sacred cenotes hide secrets darker than any legend.

title: Expedition X
description:
S02 E03 — Terror of the Bell Witch
Josh dives into one of the country's oldest witch stories; in the Tennessee backwoods, locals report being attacked in a vast cave system; Jess and Phil go underground and uncover frightening piles of bones as well as possible human remains.
